name: College Days
source: Welcome to your first year of College. You are a freshman at the highly esteemed Genetix University. As you pursue an education, you will make new friends and enemies, you will go to parties, and hopefully find love along the way. Every choice that you make will have an impact on how your story plays out, will you survive or fail to make it in college?
translation: 欢迎来到大学第一年。你是备受推崇的Genetix大学的新生。当你接受教育时，你会结交新朋友和敌人，你会参加聚会，并希望一路上找到爱情。你所做的每一个选择都会影响你的故事的发展，你会在大学生存还是失败？
